channel.title: Brazil Procurement HOT
channel.description: Government tenders from Brazil's national procurement portal PNCP across eight categories — health, education, works, transport, food, IT, services and supplies. Titles and one-line summaries are rewritten in our own words, with links to the official notices, updated every 30 minutes.

item.title: Goioerê (PR) Transport & vehicles procurement · electronic pregão (reverse auction) · closes Dec 8 #PE 57
item.description: A public buyer in Goioerê (PR) is procuring vehicles, transport or related equipment and services through electronic pregão (reverse auction), with an estimated value of about R$ 338,466.80; proposals close Dec 8, 08:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
